instruction: A candid studio portrait photograph in a medium close-up shot captures a warm family moment against a plain off-white background. In the lower center, the older man with a white beard (R1) in a light blue sweater smiles gently while looking off-camera. Clinging to his back, the young blonde boy (R4) in a patterned blue sweater on the left and the young blonde girl (R2) in a pink and white striped sweatshirt on the right wrap their arms around his neck in a tight group hug, both smiling toward the camera. The scene is illuminated by soft, even studio lighting, highlighting the pastel tones of their clothing and creating a bright, affectionate atmosphere.
